prompt: Six separate small illustrations arranged in a neat grid of two rows and three columns, all the same size. Top row from left to right: a single bare human arm from the shoulder to the hand, slightly bent at the elbow; a single open human hand with five fingers, palm facing the viewer; a pair of plain sneakers in one color without any stripes or logos. Bottom row from left to right: a gray rain cloud with many falling raindrops and a small puddle below; a single human hand that waves, with five spread fingers; a teenager in a T-shirt who holds one arm out to the side and points at it with the other hand. Every item is complete, separated from the others by wide empty white space, and does not touch the edges of the image. Modern minimalist editorial illustration, calm and refined, simplified geometric forms, flat matte colors with a very fine subtle grain, restrained palette of deep navy, slate gray, warm sand and ivory with one muted ochre accent, natural muted skin tones, minimal facial features, soft subtle shadows. Plain white background, wordless.
